target: Restore semantic-summary debt convergence, remove full recovery from the five-minute hot path, and expose bounded stage timing.
primary_semantics: Reuse an exact existing semantic queue item, bind a recreated persisted summary job to its own stable idempotency identity, and process at most eight jobs per five-minute one-shot run with no more than three concurrent model calls while preserving serialized archive ingestion.
invariants: Raw conversations and existing summaries remain immutable.
Semantic maintenance remains bounded and single-instance; only model execution may overlap, while archive and summary ingestion remain serialized.
The installer retires only the obsolete launcher and never deletes an archive.
The dashboard reads persisted bounded telemetry rather than rescanning history.
allowed_changes: Repair semantic queue reconciliation, raise the bounded batch to eight, allow at most three concurrent model calls, move full recovery auditing out of the five-minute semantic hot path, add bounded stage timing, retire the obsolete launcher after successful installation, and update release metadata.
prohibited_changes: Rewrite raw history, existing summaries, indexes, trigger thresholds, cloud protocols, or project evidence.
Run more than three model calls concurrently, overlap archive ingestion, delete a historical archive from the installer, change summary trigger thresholds, or weaken source and result validation.
before_after_checks: An exact legacy semantic payload remains idempotent.
A recreated job with the same source signature receives a distinct stable queue item.
Schedulers pass an explicit batch limit of eight and retain five-minute one-shot execution.
The semantic hot path performs a lightweight recovery-debt check and does not run a full archive audit when no explicit recovery debt is present.
At most three model calls overlap; ingestion remains serialized and one failed task does not cancel successful siblings.
Persisted timing separates preparation, model execution, validation, ingestion, and total batch time without storing prompts or source text.
A failed transaction preserves the legacy launcher; a successful transaction retires it.
Dashboard debt projection includes completed, scheduled, net pending change, duration, and batch limit.

original_triggers: A recreated L2 summary job was blocked by a completed source-signature-only queue identity.
The fixed four-job batch could fall behind sustained conversation-driven semantic debt.
